Name: Craftable Magic Rock Candy
Author: Schneitizel
Description:
Compatible SDV 1.5 !

[list]
[*]A mod to create Magic Rock Candy via your kitchen
[*]The recipe can be bought from Pierre from the third year for 50.000g
[/list]
[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b]This mod is compatible with the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5217]Gemstone Fruits[/url]" mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80494648]SilverLilly[/url]![/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*]If you don't own Gemstone Fruits, the recipe will ask you for five Prismatics Shards
[*]If you own Gemstone Fruits, the recipe will ask for Amethyst Fruit x1, Aquamarine Fruit x1, Emerald Fruit x1 Ruby Fruit x1 and Topaz Fruit x1
[/list]
[list]
[*]Mod compatible with cooking skills!
[/list]
[b][color=#cc4125][size=5]"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]" required!![/size][/color][/b]

Manifest.Name: Craftable Magic Rock Candy
Manifest.Description: Allows you to buy a recipe from Pierre to cook Magic Rock Candy. Compatible with Gemstone Fruits !
